content_html:
watched #V : Nani’s one man show….and Thaman’s Terrific BGM!!!! Just like Mohana Krishna Indraganti’s other movies…this movie also settles as a Average – Good movie and gives the audience a feeling of something is missing!!! Except Nani’s terrific and stylish performance and Thamans high octane BGM there is nothing else to either brag about or complain in this movie.

Spl mention of cinematography by P.G Vinda and few stylish action sequences. Sudheer Babu, Nivetha Thomas & Aditi Rao Hydari did their bit in the limited acope they had.
